summary.text: David Maloney is a member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for the 130th Legislative District, to which he was first elected in 2010.
His official biography names him the Republican chairman of the House Game and Fisheries Committee for the 2023-24 session.

paragraphs.text: Maloney graduated from Boyertown Area High School in 1978 and began as a process engineer with a local company before working as a self-employed contractor in construction for 25 years.
Before his election to the House, he served on the Oley Valley School Board, and he is a PIAA official and a longtime registered state wildlife agent.
The biography says Pennsylvania voters adopted in November 2017 a constitutional amendment he sponsored allowing exclusion of 100 percent of homestead and farmstead property tax assessment.
Other bills he sponsored that became law include the "Don't Pass the Trash" background-check legislation for those working with children and a law requiring schools to report known child abuse.
His stated priorities include property tax elimination, child protection, removing barriers to private-sector job creation, property rights and conservation.
He and his wife, Debby, live in Pike Township, where they raised four children.
